analysis_contract.claim_scope: this 16-turn horizon, frozen schedule, accounting, model, and runtime only
analysis_contract.curve_fits: linear and quadratic descriptive fits over observed positions 1..16 only
forbidden_interpretations: no structural or asymptotic complexity claim
primary_outputs: arm-by-position mean F, R, and gross for positions 1..16
paired-session cumulative C_w difference and ratio at H=4,8,12,16
first observed per-turn and cumulative gross crossover, if any
analysis_contract.quality: report exact-answer correctness by arm and horizon; withhold a cost-optimal recommendation if quality differs materially
analysis_contract.uncertainty: paired-session percentile bootstrap, 10000 resamples, two-sided 95% CI

approval_gate.execution_source_freeze: must be created after approval and before the first probe/model turn; it may implement but may not alter this scientific contract
required_user_approvals: 384 planned valid model turns and 480 model-spend attempt cap
experiment-only K-ARC MCP search/get in karc-full; zero in rag-bm25
the planning token range and unavailable exact dollar amount

attempt_contract.infra_failure_definition: failed call with zero normalized model usage
attempt_contract.model_spend_definition: successful turn or any failed call with non-zero normalized model usage
attempt_contract.provider_probe: not part of decision-bearing raw; requires separate explicit approval and cap

authority: user-directed E10 planning discussion (approval still pending for execution)

cost_plan.dollar_formula_per_million_tokens: 13.302163*p_fresh + 81.360973*p_cache_read + 0.117656*p_output; subscription/runtime may not expose dollar cost
cost_plan.source: E5-G1 observed positions 1..8; planning scenarios only

design.objective: measure whether the E5-G1 turn-position level-versus-growth pattern persists through position 16
design.reuse_definition: fraction of non-initial session tasks whose gold artifact was gold for an earlier task in the same session

persist: failure category and hashed error digest

before_first_turn: stop if Codex CLI is not exactly 0.144.5
stop if gpt-5.6-luna/high cannot be selected; do not substitute
stop if fixture, schedule, schema, or execution-source hash mismatches
stop until the user explicitly approves model calls and experiment-only K-ARC MCP
during_run: stop globally on missing or internally inconsistent token telemetry
stop globally on context overflow or runtime truncation; do not shorten prompts
stop globally if rag-bm25 records any K-ARC MCP search/get call
stop when any registered attempt cap is reached
stopping_contract.task_errors: grade and retain normalized metadata; task-answer error alone is not a stop
